The petitioners have filed these petitions, inter alia seeking several reliefs including recovery of the awarded compensation in respect of the land comprising in Khasra No.415/4, Village Bijwasan,
Delhi.

The present petitions are premised on the assertions that the petitioners were in possession of land in Khasra No.415, Village Bijwasan, Delhi, measuring 3 bighas and 14 biswas simple (7 bighas and 8 biswas standard).

sentences.text: 3. The petitioners being aggrieved by the order dated 13.11.1984, filed writ petition before this Court being W.P.(C) No.2742/1984.
The said petition was allowed by an order dated 06.08.2004.
The order dated 13.11.1984 passed by the learned Financial Commissioner was set aside and the matter was remitted back to the learned Financial Commissioner.
4. It is stated in the second round, the learned Financial Commissioner passed an order dated 19.01.2006 once again vesting the land in question with the Gaon Sabha.
The said order has been placed on record by the learned counsel for respondent nos.4 & 5.

The relevant extract of the said order dated 19.01.2006 are set out below:-
"4.
The relevant record - "Part Patwar" was summoned by this court and seen.
The predecessor in interest of the objector's land is Mir Singh S/o Ramnath as borne out from the receipt produced by the objectors.
Neither his name was found in "Part Partwar" nor that of the objectors.
The counsel for the petitioners/objectors referred to one Mir Singh S/o Shiv Lal at SI. No.6 which was obviously wrong and an attempt to mislead the court.

Further, the demand shown against Mir Singh S/o Shiv Lal is only 1 bigha whereas the land with the objectors is 6 bighas 6 biswas in plot No.415.
5.
It is therefore, amply clear that neither the petitioners/objectors nor their predecessor in interest This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/05/2024 at 20:39:38 made any demand for allotment of land in the extended Lal Dora during the consolidation proceedings.
Hence, the allotment of 6 bighas and 6 biswas land in plot no.415 of village Bijwasan to the petitioners/objectors suffers from illegality.

6. I, therefore, in exercise of powers u/s 42 of the Delhi Land Reforms Act, order that plot no.415 min. measuring 6 bigha and 6 biswas shall stand vested in the Gaon Sabha."
5.
The predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners was one Mir Singh s/o Ram Nath.
The learned Financial Commissioner had found that the petitioners in fact are claiming right of Mir Singh s/o Shiv Lal, which is only 1 bigha.

6. It is in the aforesaid context that the learned Financial Commissioner held that neither the predecessor-in -interest nor the petitioners had made the claim for allotment of the land in the extended lal dora during the consolidation proceedings.
The allotment of 6 bighas and 6 biswas in plot no.415 was thus, held to be suffering from illegality.

sentences.text: The petitioners had assailed the said order before this Court and thereafter before the Supreme Court, but were unsuccessful.
The said order dated 19.01.2006 has become final.

Notwithstanding the same, the petitioners, now claim that the said orders are only confined to 6 bighas and 6 biswas and the petitioners are not precluded from asserting rights in respect of the remaining land of 1 bigha and 2 biswas.
The claim of the petitioners is stoutly contested by the learned counsel for the respondents.
8. It is noted that the petitioners have not filed any of the relevant documents along with the present petitions.
However, some of the orders have been placed by the respondents.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/05/2024 at 20:39:38 9.

The petitioners are directed to file the copies of the writ petitions filed earlier including W.P.(C)
No.2742/1984 as well as other petitions filed before the revenue authorities.
The petitioners shall also file the copies of the transactions in respect of their land allegedly claimed to be sold including to one Tarkeshwar Nath and one Dina Nath Sharma.

Let the same be filed on or before 30.06.2024.
10.
List for further proceedings on 04.09.2024.
